_comment: FILTER.md Rule 7, Version 1.1. A location is split into parts on ';', '|' and '·'. Each part is checked in this order: US markers, exact US forms, full US state names, a trailing two-letter US postal code, the exact US city lookup, then non-US countries and bare non-US cities. Anything else is unknown. Lists are extended only after measuring missed locations, with a FILTER.md Version History row.

us_cities._source: City-only US names in the saved OpenAI postings (San Francisco, New York City, Seattle, Mountain View) plus my FILTER.md Version 1.0 examples. Matched exactly, ignoring case.

non_us_countries._source: Country names and the short forms used in the saved postings (UK, UAE, NL, CAN, IE, CH). 'Georgia' is left out because US state names are checked first. 'IN' is left out because it is Indiana's postal code.

non_us_bare_cities._source: Bare non-US city names that appear in the saved postings without a country. Matched exactly, ignoring case, after removing a trailing ' - Remote'.
